name: Runerigus
description: Runerigus, the Grudge Pokémon, and the evolved form of Yamask. A Ground and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
